title: fairtest: code, models and case files for fair adversarial testing of automated vehicles in highway cut-ins
description: Companion code of the paper "Fair adversarial testing of automated vehicles in highway cut-ins: reference-shielded attacks and a capability-controlled evaluation". It contains the agent, the systems under test, the reference drivers, the shield, the searches, the analyses and the dataset extractors, the trained models, the case identifiers and derived case files, and the Autoware and CARLA files. The documentation that the paper cites is in the docs folder.
